natural_language: Find Priya Sharma
reference_sql: SELECT c.* FROM candidates c WHERE c.name LIKE '%Priya Sharma%' LIMIT 500

natural_language: Who is in screening right now?
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE c.current_stage = 1 LIMIT 500

natural_language: Who has been stuck in screening for more than a week?
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE c.current_stage = 1 AND datetime(c.entered_screening_at) <= datetime('now', '-7 days') LIMIT 500

natural_language: Who moved to screening since Monday?
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE datetime(c.entered_screening_at) >= datetime('now', 'start of day', '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', 'now') AS INTEGER) + 6) % 7) || ' days') LIMIT 500

natural_language: Who reached the offer stage but did not get hired?
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE c.offered_flag = 1 AND c.hired_flag = 0 LIMIT 500

natural_language: Everyone except rejected candidates
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE c.current_stage != -1 LIMIT 500

natural_language: List candidates applying for POS-102 Product Designer
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c JOIN positions p ON p.id = c.position_id WHERE p.position_code = 'POS-102' LIMIT 500

natural_language: Show all hired candidates
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE c.current_stage = 3 LIMIT 500

natural_language: Who is still in applied stage?
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE c.current_stage = 0 LIMIT 500

natural_language: Rejected candidates who had received an offer
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE c.current_stage = -1 AND c.offered_flag = 1 LIMIT 500

natural_language: Candidates currently at offer stage
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE c.current_stage = 2 LIMIT 500

natural_language: Find Marcus Lee
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE c.name LIKE '%Marcus Lee%' LIMIT 500

natural_language: Data Analyst opening candidates in screening
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c JOIN positions p ON p.id = c.position_id WHERE p.position_code = 'POS-103' AND c.current_stage = 1 LIMIT 500

natural_language: Senior Backend Engineer candidates not rejected
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c JOIN positions p ON p.id = c.position_id WHERE p.position_code = 'POS-101' AND c.current_stage != -1 LIMIT 500

natural_language: Who entered offered stage since Monday?
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c WHERE datetime(c.entered_offered_at) >= datetime('now', 'start of day', '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', 'now') AS INTEGER) + 6) % 7) || ' days') LIMIT 500

natural_language: Screening candidates for POS-101 with name containing Amit
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c JOIN positions p ON p.id = c.position_id WHERE p.position_code = 'POS-101' AND c.current_stage = 1 AND c.name LIKE '%Amit%' LIMIT 500

natural_language: How many candidates are in each stage? Show stage and count.
reference_sql: SELECT current_stage, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM candidates GROUP BY current_stage LIMIT 500
notes: Aggregate query; eval compares row count only when expected ids empty

natural_language: Candidates rejected while still in applied
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM candidates c JOIN stage_events e ON e.candidate_id = c.id WHERE c.current_stage = -1 AND e.to_stage = -1 AND e.from_stage = 0 LIMIT 500

natural_language: Find Noah Kim and show if hired
reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.hired_flag FROM candidates c WHERE c.name LIKE '%Noah Kim%' LIMIT 500
